rationale: Enterprise MSP dashboard requiring extreme data density, F-pattern scanning, and an operational 'control room' feel. Linear/Superhuman aesthetic demands high contrast, 1px borders, and removal of soft shadows.

layout_strategy.overall: Master-Detail F-Pattern layout. A fixed top navigation/metric strip, followed by a left-side client list (35% width) and a right-side persistent detail pane (65% width).
layout_strategy.top_strip: grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 px-6 py-4 border-b border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-20
layout_strategy.master_list: flex flex-col border-r border-zinc-800 h-[calc(100vh-80px)] overflow-y-auto w-[35%] bg-zinc-950
layout_strategy.detail_pane: flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-80px)] overflow-y-auto w-[65%] bg-zinc-900/30
layout_strategy.spacing_scale: Extremely dense. p-2 to p-4 max inside widgets. Use gap-2 for metadata.

top_strip_metrics.style: Minimal bento. No background, just a left border `border-l-2 border-indigo-500 pl-4`. Includes tiny sparklines.
top_strip_metrics.anatomy: Micro label (uppercase) + Large metric value + subtle trend indicator (e.g., '+2.4%').

client_list_card.style: Rectangle, no border-radius rounding, 1px border-b border-zinc-800. Hover state: `bg-zinc-900 cursor-pointer transition-colors`.
client_list_card.anatomy: Logo (rounded-md, not full circle for B2B) + Client Name + Industry Tag + Status Dot. Right aligned: MRR with micro-sparkline. Bottom row: Integration micro-dots (sky, indigo, cyan) + Health Score Badge.

health_score_dial.style: SVG circular progress. 32x32px. Stroke width 3. Gradient stroke based on score. Center text: Score (e.g., '92').

integration_chips.style: h-6 px-2 rounded-md border text-xs flex items-center gap-1 font-mono

detail_tabs.style: Linear-style horizontal tabs. `border-b border-zinc-800`. Active tab: `border-b-2 border-indigo-500 text-zinc-100`. Inactive: `text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-300`.

quick_action_fab.style: Floating at bottom-center of detail pane. Pill-shaped command menu `rounded-full border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800/90 backdrop-blur-lg shadow-2xl px-2 py-2 flex gap-2`. Includes iconic buttons with tooltips for shortcuts (e.g., [T] New Ticket).

empty_states.style: Centralized, using ASCII/Terminal retro-tech aesthetic or simple stark wireframe icons. Heavy text guidance with primary CTA.

motion_and_interactions.detail_pane_load: Fade and slight slide-up (framer-motion: `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`).
motion_and_interactions.list_item_hover: No lifting (`-translate-y` is banned for this dense layout). Change background only `hover:bg-zinc-800/50`.
motion_and_interactions.active_state: The selected client in the list gets a persistent left-border: `border-l-2 border-indigo-500 bg-zinc-900`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a dense, high-end technical feel.
Implement Recharts for the MRR/ARR 12-month sparklines. Hide all axes and grids; just render the line with a gradient stroke and a dot at the current month.
Do not use Shadcn 'Cards' with border-radius and shadows for the list view. Use raw HTML/Tailwind to create a dense, flat, border-bottom separated list item layout.
Use standard Radix/Shadcn components heavily for the Detail Pane (Tabs, Progress, Dialog, DropdownMenu).
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='client-list-item-0', data-testid='tab-overview').
Use flex layouts to strictly clamp heights (h-screen minus topbar) and set overflow-y-auto so the left list and right pane scroll independently.
